messages:
ops-alert-bot: 🔴 ALERT: Spike in 5xx for /v1/generate from multiple customers in us-west-2. Error surface is 5xx, upstream shows quota-service timeouts. Aggregated at 18:42 UTC.

jess (SRE): seeing it, joining. stack traces show gateway -> quota-service -> timeout. load looks normal but errors suddenly jump at 18:41.

amar (Support): multiple customer tickets reporting 502/503 on generate endpoints, some billing calls about failed requests. customers: acme-inc, tilebyte, hypershop.

taylor (Eng-API): grabbing request ids. example: X-Request-ID: 0a1b2c3d. Gateway log: `upstream connect error or disconnect before headers. reset reason: connection failure` then `timeout waiting for response from quota-service`.

leo (Infra): quick check: quota-service targets got a canary deployed ~10m ago (rate-limiter-v2). Endpoint registration looked fine but health checks flapping on a subset of nodes. could be misroute to unhealthy pod.

jess (SRE): reproducing with curl now:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
response: 502 Bad Gateway, body:
```
{"error":"upstream timeout","service":"gateway","upstream":"quota-service","upstream_status":504}
```

amar (Support): customers want ETA and whether they'll be charged. recommended: reply acknowledging and promise no billing for failed attempts.

taylor (Eng-API): looking at router logs, some requests are routed to `quota-service-blue` which has a broken env var `QUOTA_CACHE_HOST` that causes immediate downstream timeouts. Should have been filtered by service discovery.

marta (Platform): rollback option: remove the canary from the service registry or flip traffic back to `quota-service-legacy`. We can also add a temporary route rule to force quota traffic to legacy cluster.

leo (Infra): adding patch to route table now. If we push rule, it should take effect within ~45s. prepping rollback if needed.

jess (SRE): mitigation checklist: 1) route quota calls to legacy, 2) scale replica count of legacy +2, 3) add mapping to treat quota-service dependency timeouts as 4xx/429 for client-facing errors instead of 5xx. We should avoid automatic mapping until we confirm semantics.

taylor (Eng-API): note: current behavior returns 502/504 because gateway treats upstream timeout as gateway error. Quota semantics: lack of quota should be 429 or 403 (depending). We need classification logic in gateway: if upstream returns `QuotaDenied` or `quota-timeout` -> return 429 with structured body. But for upstream timeouts we still need to be careful.

amar (Support): can you confirm whether this caused any successful token charge events? I want to confirm billing side.

jess (SRE): early metric check: token consumption spikes did not correlate; most requests failed before tokens consumed. we should waive failed attempts as precaution.

leo (Infra): route rule applied to force traffic to legacy. monitoring now shows error rate dropping in 12s.

deploy-bot: deploy rollback to service-discovery (canary deregister) started by marta at 18:44:12 UTC.

marta (Platform): canary deregister complete. health metrics show steady success in quota path.

jess (SRE): errors back to baseline in ~30s after reroute. creating incident doc and timeline.

taylor (Eng-API): postmortem items:
- fix service discovery filter that allowed canary with broken env into endpoints list
- add explicit mapping in gateway to map quota-denied vs quota-timeout to 4xx (429) with helpful body
- add circuit-breaker and shorter failover for quota calls so gateway returns a clear client-facing status rather than 5xx
- add integration test that simulates quota-service timeout and asserts classification

amar (Support): I will send org-wide status to impacted accounts and mark billing waive for failed requests between 18:41 and 18:44 UTC.

jess (SRE): owners:
- incident lead: jess (SRE)
- platform rollback: marta (Platform)
- root cause eng: taylor (Eng-API)
- infra routing: leo (Infra)
- support comms: amar (Support)

jess (SRE): creating incident bridge and postmortem ticket. expect a full writeup in 24-48h. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

amar (Support): acked. I’ll follow up on all customer threads with workaround and compensation note.

marta (Platform): will open a PR to add a kube admission check to prevent env-misconfig canaries from registering.

taylor (Eng-API): quick repro notes for postmortem:
- repeated POSTs with small concurrency reproduce 502 when routed to bad canary
- log snippet: `quota_client.go:142: request timeout after 2s -> upstream 504 -> gateway converted to 502`
- `X-Request-ID: 0a1b2c3d` sample trace linked in logs.

jess (SRE): closing thread on slack, full incident thread in our incident tracker. If any customer escalations come in, route to amar.

ops-alert-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: error rate normalized at 18:44:55 UTC. root cause suspected misrouted canary (config env var causing timeouts). Postmortem in progress.
